tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Window and screen background behind every card and glass surface (AppColors.background).

tokens.name: card-background
tokens.usage: Translation result cards and solid panels; also the base of glass tints at 10–24% opacity (AppColors.cardBackground).

tokens.name: input-background
tokens.usage: Text fields and picker rows; glass fallback tint at 70% for tappable rows (AppColors.inputBackground).

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body copy, translations and titles on background, card-background and input-background.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Metadata, timestamps, hints, unselected chevrons and icons on background and card-background.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, icons, progress tints and the language arrow. Resolves to the user theme: the -strong variant in light mode (legible on white), the base variant in dark mode. Default theme is Ocean (blue).

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Fill behind on-accent content: selected chips, send buttons, primary capsules, primary metadata chips. Always the -strong variant so white text stays at or above 4.5:1.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-fill and on error fills.

tokens.name: chip-primary-background
tokens.usage: Fill of the selected action chip and primary metadata chip.

tokens.name: chip-primary-text
tokens.usage: Label on chip-primary-background. White on the default blue is 3.9:1 — below 4.5:1 at 14px medium; kept exact from source.

tokens.name: chip-secondary-background
tokens.usage: Unselected chips, user message bubbles and quiet fills.

tokens.name: chip-secondary-text
tokens.usage: Label on chip-secondary-background.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card outlines and the 1px stroke of every glass fallback surface. Decorative only — too faint to carry meaning.

tokens.name: skeleton
tokens.usage: Loading placeholders while a model streams its first tokens.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed-run checkmark and success states, always beside a word or SF Symbol. Light value is 3.3:1 on white — icon use only, not body text.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Failed-run messages and retry prompts on card-background; always paired with an icon. Differs from success in hue and lightness.

tokens.name: accent-orange
tokens.usage: Accent theme “Sunset”. Also the legacy brand orange still declared in AppColors.accent.

tokens.name: accent-orange-strong
tokens.usage: Darkened orange for fills and light-mode accent text (white text >= 4.5:1). Only reference via accent / accent-fill.

tokens.name: accent-blue
tokens.usage: Accent theme “Ocean” — the default accent.

tokens.name: accent-blue-strong
tokens.usage: Darkened blue for fills and light-mode accent text (white text >= 4.5:1). Only reference via accent / accent-fill.

tokens.name: accent-purple
tokens.usage: Accent theme “Lavender”.

tokens.name: accent-purple-strong
tokens.usage: Darkened purple for fills and light-mode accent text (white text >= 4.5:1). Only reference via accent / accent-fill.

tokens.name: accent-pink
tokens.usage: Accent theme “Rose”.

tokens.name: accent-pink-strong
tokens.usage: Darkened pink for fills and light-mode accent text (white text >= 4.5:1). Only reference via accent / accent-fill.

tokens.name: accent-green
tokens.usage: Accent theme “Forest”.

tokens.name: accent-green-strong
tokens.usage: Darkened green for fills and light-mode accent text (white text >= 4.5:1). Only reference via accent / accent-fill.

tokens.name: accent-red
tokens.usage: Accent theme “Ruby”.

tokens.name: accent-red-strong
tokens.usage: Darkened red for fills and light-mode accent text (white text >= 4.5:1). Only reference via accent / accent-fill.

tokens.name: accent-teal
tokens.usage: Accent theme “Teal”.

tokens.name: accent-teal-strong
tokens.usage: Darkened teal for fills and light-mode accent text (white text >= 4.5:1). Only reference via accent / accent-fill.

tokens.name: accent-indigo
tokens.usage: Accent theme “Indigo”.

tokens.name: accent-indigo-strong
tokens.usage: Darkened indigo for fills and light-mode accent text (white text >= 4.5:1). Only reference via accent / accent-fill.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default interface text — the most used size.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Inline actions, error titles, menu items.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: SF Symbol size inside metadata chips; badges.

styles.name: md-h1
styles.usage: Heading 1 in compact result cards (detail 22px, prominent 24px).

styles.name: md-h2
styles.usage: Heading 2 in compact result cards (detail 19px, prominent 22px).

styles.name: md-h3
styles.usage: Heading 3 in compact result cards (detail 17px, prominent 20px).

styles.name: md-body
styles.sample: Model output renders here, streaming in.
styles.usage: Result text in compact cards and the keyboard/extension. Bold is semibold (600).

styles.name: md-body-detail
styles.sample: Detail view reads a little larger.
styles.usage: Result text in history and detail screens.

styles.name: md-code
styles.usage: Inline and block code, underlined in accent.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps, metadata chip vertical padding. (TLingoSpacing.xxs)

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Default stack spacing; chip horizontal padding; bubble vertical padding. (TLingoSpacing.xs)

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between action chips; bubble horizontal padding. (TLingoSpacing.sm)

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card padding; action chip horizontal padding; gap between result cards. (TLingoSpacing.md)

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Screen horizontal margins. (TLingoSpacing.lg)

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section separation and sheet insets. (TLingoSpacing.xl)

tokens.name: radius-8
tokens.usage: Skeleton bars, thumbnails, small badges and inline controls. (TLingoRadius.small)

tokens.name: radius-12
tokens.usage: Cards, result cards, message bubbles, list rows, collapsed composer. (TLingoRadius.medium)

tokens.name: radius-18
tokens.usage: Composer, language bar, floating panels, realtime controls. (TLingoRadius.large)

tokens.name: radius-24
tokens.usage: Large docked bars such as the realtime transport bar. (TLingoRadius.extraLarge)

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, language pills, capsule buttons.

shadow.note: SwiftUI shadow radius is written as the CSS blur. Most surfaces are flat or Liquid Glass; shadows lift only floating windows.

tokens.name: shadow-popup
tokens.usage: Text-selection popup translation window.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Realtime progress overlay.

tokens.name: shadow-prompt
tokens.usage: Satisfaction prompt toast.

tokens.name: shadow-banner
tokens.usage: Saved-notice banner.

tokens.name: shadow-caption
tokens.usage: Realtime floating and notch captions over arbitrary content.

tokens.name: shadow-accent-glow
tokens.usage: Selected paywall plan and primary purchase button: accent at 20% (shown with the default blue).
